text:
Developing a mobile app involves more than just writing code. A crucial first step is deciding between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one system, like iOS or Android, offering the best performance. Cross-platform tools allow one codebase for both, saving time but sometimes sacrificing speed.

Regardless of the choice, responsive design is essential. A screen must adapt to various devices, from small phones to large tablets, ensuring buttons and text are easily usable. Once built, the app must pass review to appear on app stores like Google Play or the App Store. Finally, developers constantly monitor performance, fixing bugs and optimizing load times to keep users satisfied.
